data.body: 2026-08-01: Replaced Schemars custom `format: uint` annotations on every currently MCP-exposed `usize` count with portable JSON Schema `{ type: integer, minimum: 0 }` fragments. Affected design overview maxDepth, scope childrenDepth, search limit, design-save changedCount, and task mockup contentIndex without changing their Rust/wire values. Added a schema regression and verified cargo fmt, all 55 Rust library tests, a fresh debug adashi-mcp build, and fresh stdio tools/list with no remaining `format: uint` occurrence.
